profile.headline: Software Engineer at U.S. Bank
profile.summary:
One of the joys of working on a team is getting to know the people you work with. I have had the pleasure of working on several teams throughout my career, and as a result have had the opportunity to interact with many different types of people. It is a very rewarding experience to mentor colleagues and to see them grow in knowledge and experience, just as I have grown from the help of my own mentors. I have also frequently worked with end users, which has not only given me the fulfillment of being able to help them, but has also given me a more thorough knowledge of the business process.

As a Software Engineer, I have extensive experience supporting, extending, and customizing vital business applications. My flexibility as an employee has provided me with experience in a variety of systems. I am always ready to adapt to change, learn new technologies and programming languages, and use my strong problem solving skills to support the business in whatever way I am needed.

Specialties: Strong knowledge of the Order Management and Supply Chain applications:

Oracle EBS 11i
 - Oracle Database 10g
 - Oracle XML/BI Publisher
 - Oracle Reports 6i
 - Oracle Forms 6i
 - Oracle Workflow Builder
 - SQLDeveloper, PLSQL Developer, SQLPLUS

FormScape

Yantra DCM (Order Management)

Yantra DCS and Sterling WMS (Warehouse Management)

Extensive experience with multiple languages:
- SQL, PL/SQL
- XML / XSL
- HTML / CSS / JSP
- Java 1.5,1.6
- C/C++

Experience with Oracle SOA Suite 11g.

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description: Temporarily returned as a consultant to ensure on-time delivery of urgent enhancements to the Warehouse Management System. Provided technical designs and guidance. Performed technical reviews.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Provided end-user support using BMC Remedy AR System.

Provided support and developed enhancements for:
- Yantra DCS
- Yantra Order Management
- Oracle EBS

Primary developer and administrator for FormScape, which is used to generate and send customer-facing, vendor-facing, and financial documents.

Did technical design and developed customizations for an upgrade from Yantra DCS 6.2 to Sterling WMS, which involved Java, HTML, JSP, XML, UNIX, SQL, along with extensive configuration, testing, and documentation.

Developed composites and BPEL processes using Oracle SOA Suite.

Developed documentation as part of the Software Development Life Cycle, including:
- AIM Methodology documents (MD.070 / MD.120 / TE.020)
- Other documents, such as flow charts and UML diagrams

Experience using CVS (version control system).

Experience with change management and release management tools, including:
- PMEase QuickBuild
- BMC Remedy AR System

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst Intern
positions.description: Developed C++ applications using Microsoft Visual Studio. Developed OLE servers to be used in-house. Gathered requirements from end users and created graphical user interfaces.
